hooks.prompt: A git commit was just made. Review the changes by running `git diff HEAD~1 HEAD`. Focus on: CSS/JS anti-patterns (e.g. display:flex/grid on elements that also use the HTML `hidden` attribute, which causes the hidden attribute to have no effect); security issues in FastAPI auth or cookie handling; correctness bugs in Python or JavaScript; missing test coverage for new code paths. Report only real findings — skip style nitpicks and issues already covered by the pre-commit ruff/pytest hooks.
